The '''''Agitator''''' was a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the ship was seen in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]].
